searchText: Sharing a summary of the intersection of Lighthouse’s team members opinions towards an EIP set for Electra https://hackmd.io/@dapplion/lighthouse_pectra hey all, practically speaking, do you think dropping support for `ExecutionPayloadV1` responses to `getPayloadV2` is fair? Our Sepolia and Holesky Deneb release is out. https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/releases/tag/v4.6.0 hey all, practically speaking, do you ACDC in 45 minutes Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/938 zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91725886939?pwd=b2kzT0JGeFAzTmhyb1BYSTgrZ0xwdz09 call in 5 minutes Small process note: we should probably move all the Dencun EIPs to `Last Call` given they are already live on testnets! <dankrad> Talked about sample verification on the call — Justin Traglia has now added the data for aggregated verification. For 1d Peerdas 1 column = 1 sample: https://notes.ethereum.org/WcT6jxTcSkGbNJpZomut4A?view#Batch-column-sample-verification
